svg.title: One question answered by three execution modes
svg.desc: Verbatim answer excerpts, saved tool timelines, and source references for the shared GAN-downscaling question (R2Q10) from the saved three-mode run over the 100-paper corpus; all modes used the same agent harness and model. A, the QDCVR platform, runs one two-stage search and one document read, then quotes the answer with base, document, and section references, confirmed by a direct read. B, a bare agent with file tools, globs the 100 exported files, greps once, reads the paper file, and names the file with section and line. C, an agent restricted to dense retrieval over one 800-character chunk index, issues one vector search and lists the chunk file names used. Ellipses elide text and markdown emphasis is removed; source lines are condensed to fit. Comparable answer quality is expected on this question: the demonstrated difference is addressability of evidence, not an accuracy ranking.
